# Create E2 Diver gym scene

## Problem statement

Create a Phaser gym scene demonstrating the E2 Diver enemy — the diving attacker from GDD §4.2. The scene should show its curved-dive trajectory toward the player, then return to formation. This medium-threat enemy introduces dynamic movement patterns beyond simple formation flight.

## Users

- **Player / developer** testing enemy behaviour — wants to see the Diver's dive-and-return movement pattern in isolation.
- **AI agents implementing AI_Hell** — need a reference implementation of diving enemy movement logic.

### Example user stories

- As a **developer**, I want to see Diver enemies periodically break from formation and dive toward the player position so I can verify the curved trajectory movement code.
- As a **developer**, I want to click a button to destroy a random Diver and see its explosion animation so I can verify destruction logic.
- As a **developer**, I want to toggle the Diver's shooting behaviour on/off so I can test both diving-only and shooting modes independently.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Gym scene exists:** A Phaser scene (`src/scenes/gym/GymDiver.ts`) renders Diver enemies in formation with periodic dive behaviour.
- [ ] **AC2 — Diver visual style:** Divers render as medium, dart-shaped neon entities (yellow `#ffff00` per GDD §4.1) consistent with the player ship aesthetic.
- [ ] **AC3 — Dive-and-return movement:** Enemies periodically break from formation, follow a curved trajectory toward the player position, then return to their formation position.
- [ ] **AC4 — Explode button:** A button on-screen destroys a random Diver enemy with an explosion animation when clicked.
- [ ] **AC5 — Toggle shoot button:** A button toggles whether Divers fire short-burst spread shots (simulating Level 4+ behaviour). When off, Divers only dive. When on, they periodically fire spread shots during dives.
- [ ] **AC6 — Enemy pass-through verified:** Divers pass freely through each other without collision (per GDD §2.6).
- [ ] **AC7 — All related documentation is updated** to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- [ ] **AC8 — Full project test suite must pass** with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Engine:** Phaser v4 + TypeScript.
- **Gym scope:** This scene is a standalone gym scene (not shipped with the game) — no player ship, no other enemy types, no HUD, no power-ups.
- **Enemy behaviour:** Divers are 1 HP, destroyed by a single bullet. No health bar needed.
- **Dive trigger:** Divers should dive periodically (e.g., every 3–5 seconds) with enough spacing between dives to avoid overlap.
- **Firing:** When shoot mode is toggled on, Divers fire a short-burst spread (3–5 projectiles at slight angles) during their dive trajectory.
- **Audio:** Play distinct sound effects for spawn, dive (descending tone per GDD §7.3), and destruction.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/scenes/gym/GymDiver.ts` — The Diver gym scene.
- `src/entities/Diver.ts` — Diver enemy entity (formation + dive + firing logic).
- `src/assets/` — Diver sprite (yellow dart shape).
- `src/audio/` — Diver-related sound effects (spawn, dive, destruction).

## Related work

- **Create E1 Scout gym scene (AH-0MT994ESD000RP1Q)** — related; implements V-formation pattern.
- **Refactor Enemy Gym Scenes (AH-0MT985FOA008JWM9)** — related; will refactor code across enemy gym scenes.
- **Gym index scene (AH-0MT985VRY009JXLZ)** — related; will link to this scene from the gym index.
- **Game Design Document (AH-0MT7O8KCY0059RA5)** — authoritative spec, §4.1 E2 Diver definition.
